content.text: fazer a seção de Speaking completa em formato simulado:

blocos de sentido · ganchos · chunks · começar em 1–2 s · terminações -s/-ed

questions.questionText: I need to ______ up my answer in the last 5 seconds. (concluir)

explanations.general: I need to wrap up my answer in the last 5 seconds.

questions.questionText: For a personal question in the interview, which structure?

explanations.general: Correct answer: D-D-E: direct answer, detail, example

questions.questionText: For an opinion question, which structure?

explanations.general: Correct answer: P-R-E: position, reason, example

questions.questionText: I tend to ______ before answering. I need to start faster. (hesitar)

explanations.general: I tend to hesitate before answering.

questions.questionText: In Listen and Repeat, you should wait 5 seconds before repeating.

content.text: Como funciona o simulado de hoje
— 7 frases em um contexto (tour pela biblioteca), da mais curta para a mais longa.
— 4 perguntas de um entrevistador: pessoal → preferência → opinião → situação hipotética.
Sem pedir repetição. Sem anotar na parte de repetição.
Na entrevista: comece em até 3 s; fale até 45 s.
. A próxima frase é uma nova chance.
2 perfeita · 1 sentido completo com pequenos erros · 0 perdeu conteúdo
responde a pergunta? · desenvolve com razão/exemplo? · fluência · gramática/vocabulário · pronúncia
4.1 Mini aquecimento de Repeat (professor lê, aluno repete)
The reading room is on the third floor.
Please keep your voice down in the quiet zone.
You can reserve a study room for up to three hours.
4.2 Mini aquecimento de Interview (20 s cada)
What's your favorite place in your city? (D-D-E)
Would you rather read a book or watch the movie version? (preferência)
, but I need to work on
→ the interview / giving concrete examples → the opinion question / stating my position faster → the hypothetical question / using “I'd” correctly

content.text: 🎧 Cada frase uma vez; repetição imediata.
The main entrance is open from seven to midnight.
Group study rooms are located on the second floor.
Please return borrowed laptops to the help desk before closing.
Students can print up to fifty pages a week for free.
If you need help finding a book, you can ask a librarian at the reference desk.
During final exams, the library stays open twenty-four hours, but only students with a valid ID can enter after midnight.
🎧 O professor faz o papel do entrevistador (voz neutra, sem ajudar).
Thanks for joining me. First, tell me a little about how you usually study.
Would you rather study in a library or at a café? Why?
Some people think universities should stop giving grades. What's your opinion?
Imagine you are asked to lead a group project with people you don't know. What would you do first?
O aluno diz em inglês, com ajuda do professor:
[ ] Repeat: manteve as frases 6 e 7 (longas) com sentido completo?
[ ] Interview: estrutura certa para cada tipo de pergunta?
[ ] Manteve o foco do início ao fim, sem “desligar” entre as partes?
[ ] Os 2 ajustes são concretos e têm um treino definido?
Faça o treino que você definiu por 15 minutos.
Grave as 7 frases (texto-para-voz) em ordem aleatória e repita. Meta: 12/14.
Faça o treino que você definiu.
Grave as 4 perguntas do simulado com cronômetro.
Ouça as gravações do dia 4 com a rubrica (1–5) e dê nota a si mesmo.

Tell me about a teacher who influenced you. / Would you rather take classes in the morning or evening? / Should university students have to do volunteer work? / Imagine your roommate wants to study abroad and asks for advice. What would you say?
